Course

Vibecoding from zero with t27: describe it, run it, let a test judge it

You describe what you want, an AI agent writes it, you run it and a test says yes or no. No programming needed to start: every lesson opens a small tool and a spec you can run in your browser.

Course 12, 27 lessons, one widget and one t27 spec each, for a reader who has never programmed: what vibecoding is, your desk, save points with git, prompting, the working loop, a test as the judge, the parts of an agent, a first bot and your own project.

Open the interactive course →
